top_signals.title: Fed's Warsh withholds Fed rate signal, praises recent global tightening with 'no free riders'
top_signals.summary: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Metals Rebound as Sentiment Improves After US Inflation Shock
top_signals.summary: Metals — including copper, aluminum and zinc — rebounded in London after a shaky few days of trading fueled by fears of more aggressive tightening by the Federal Reserve.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: The data centre IPO debacle that sparked a market meltdown
top_signals.summary: Decisions by Australian groups Firmus and AirTrunk have added to concerns about the AI borrowing frenzy
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Apple and Meta team up to make Muse AI model run on Mac computers
top_signals.summary: Apple and Meta are collaborating to make Muse Spark Open easier to run locally on clustered Mac Studio systems, according to the companies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Army to stand up second expeditionary cyber battalion in coming months
top_signals.summary: The head of U.S. Army Cyber Command said this week that the service would be building an exact replica of the 11th Cyber Battalion in the next few months.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
